nodes.label: Lesson: stacked PR base trap

nodes.label: Principle: celebrate, never shame
nodes.rationale: Stale items are invitations; no XP loss, no comparison

nodes.label: Principle: untouched-first ordering
nodes.rationale: Neglected work rises to top; in-progress pinned; done/dropped sink; shown as intentional via last-touched meta

nodes.label: Builder cannot review own work
nodes.rationale: The agent that builds is always different from the agent that reviews
